set.body: Add mechanical and statistical validation: constant map invariance, impulse smoothing, boundary no-leak behavior for mask-aware mode, neuroim2 adapter parity under boundary = neuroim2, reference determinism on tiny arrays, null_from_maps validation, monotone FDR, result-class contract, null simulations for empirical FDR behavior, and comparison fixtures showing LISA is complementary to max-T/TFCE/scale-space energy. Optional adjoin backend tests should skip cleanly if adjoin is not installed.
